short: Moves from one computer to others, closer to what’s valuable.
analogy: From the hallway, goes through every room.

solutionNotes.ueba: Spots unusual connections: an accountant doesn’t log in to a domain controller.
solutionNotes.ndr: Sees movement between computers in network traffic.
solutionNotes.siem: Builds the chain of logins from machine to machine.
solutionNotes.pam: Isolates administrative access so a stolen password can’t be used to walk everywhere.
solutionNotes.edr: Spots remote command execution and tool transfers.
solutionNotes.deception: Traps in the network go off as soon as the attacker goes “deeper.”
